title: TraceSeal
description: Terminal completeness anchor per interaction_id: expected_final_sequence + terminal_record_sha256 over canonical JSON of final InteractionTrace record; verifies no truncation/deletion/reordering and is anchored in an append-only committed manifest (seal immutability)

interaction_id.description: UUID matching the sealed InteractionTrace set

expected_final_sequence.description: Expected max trace_sequence for this interaction_id; verification must reject unless trace set is contiguous 0..expected_final_sequence

terminal_record_sha256.description: sha256(canonical_json(final InteractionTrace record)) for trace_sequence==expected_final_sequence; verification must recompute canonical hash of final record and compare
